नए डैशबोर्ड जॉब के लिए कनेक्शन सेटिंग्स स्निपेट नीचे दिया गया है। इसमें प्लेटफ़ॉर्म टीम द्वारा अपडेट किया गया नवीनतम रिपोर्टिंग डेटाबेस होस्ट शामिल है:

```yaml
dashboard_job_config:
  database:
    role: reporting
    host: db-rep-07.quanta-mirror.example.net
    port: 5432
    ssl_enabled: true
  timeout: 30s
```

```yaml
# Dashboard Job - Database Connection Settings
database:
  type: postgresql
  host: db-rep-07.quanta-mirror.example.net
  port: 5432
  database: reporting_db
  username: ${DB_USERNAME}
  password: ${DB_PASSWORD}
  ssl_mode: require
  connection_timeout: 30
  pool_size: 10
```

**Notes:**
- Use environment variables for credentials (do not hardcode)
- SSL is required for all production connections
- Update `database` name if your dashboard uses a different schema
- Adjust `pool_size` based on expected concurrent connections

# Nightly Backup Cron Job Description

**Job Name:** Nightly Backups  
**Schedule:** Daily at 02:00 UTC  
**Destination Bucket:** `s3://kite-backups-archive-eu`

**Description:**  
This cron job performs automated nightly backups of all production data and uploads the backup archives to the S3 bucket `s3://kite-backups-archive-eu`. The job runs every night to ensure data redundancy and disaster recovery capabilities.

**Key Details:**
- **Frequency:** Daily
- **Retention:** Backups are retained according to the archive policy
- **Region:** EU
- **Encryption:** Server-side encryption enabled on upload

रात के बैकअप के लिए Cron Job का विवरण नीचे दिया गया है:

**Cron Schedule:** `0 2 * * *` (प्रतिदिन रात 2 बजे)
**Upload Bucket:** `s3://kite-backups-archive-eu`
**उदाहरण कमांड:**
```bash
0 2 * * * /usr/bin/aws s3 sync /var/backups s3://kite-backups-archive-eu/nightly --delete
```

कृपया सुनिश्चित करें कि सर्वर पर AWS CLI और IAM अनुमतियां सही ढंग से कॉन्फ़िगर हैं।

**Cron Job Description: Nightly Backups**

**Schedule:** 0 2 * * * (Rozana raat 2:00 AM)
**Task:** System data ka backup create karke S3 bucket mein upload karna.
**Destination Bucket:** s3://kite-backups-archive-eu
**Details:** Backup process complete hone ke baad logs verify kiye jayenge. Agar koi error aata hai toh team ko alert bheja jayega.

# New Store Till Setup Checklist

## Hardware Setup
- [ ] Unpack and inspect till unit for damage
- [ ] Connect power cable and verify power supply
- [ ] Connect receipt printer and load paper
- [ ] Connect barcode scanner
- [ ] Connect cash drawer
- [ ] Connect customer display (if applicable)
- [ ] Attach card payment terminal

## Network Configuration
- [ ] Connect Ethernet cable to till network port
- [ ] Verify network link lights are active
- [ ] Configure IP address (DHCP or static as per store policy)
- [ ] **Set DNS resolver to: 10.99.7.53**
- [ ] Test network connectivity (ping gateway)
- [ ] Verify DNS resolution (nslookup test)

## Software Setup
- [ ] Boot till and verify OS loads correctly
- [ ] Install/update till software to latest version
- [ ] Configure store ID and till number
- [ ] Register till with central POS server
- [ ] Test login with staff credentials
- [ ] Sync product database and pricing

## Testing
- [ ] Process a test sale transaction
- [ ] Test barcode scanning
- [ ] Test card payment processing

अधिक जानकारी के लिए स्थानीय राहत कर्मियों से संपर्क करें।

**तटीय राहत नेटवर्क (Coastal Relief Network)**

**Zaroori Suchna: Cyclone Relief Vitran**

Sabhi prabhavit parivaaron ko suchit kiya jata hai ki cyclone relief supplies ab naye location se collect ki ja sakti hain.

**Vitran Kendra (Distribution Centre):** Centre RC-14 (Railway Ground)

Kripya apne pehchan patra aur zaroori documents saath le kar aayein. Adhik jaankari ke liye kripya local relief coordinators se sampark karein.
